mapper.sql: SELECT d.id AS dishId, d.name AS dishName, m.name AS merchantName, c.name AS canteenName, c.type AS canteenType, d.average_score AS score, d.price, d.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, d.view_count AS viewCount, d.review_count AS reviewCount, d.cover_image_url AS coverImageUrl FROM dish d INNER JOIN merchant m ON m.id = d.merchant_id INNER JOIN stall s ON s.id = d.stall_id INNER JOIN canteen c ON c.id = d.canteen_id

WHERE d.status IN ('ON_SALE', 'SOLD_OUT') AND m.apply_status = 'APPROVED' AND m.status = 'OPEN' AND s.status = 'OPEN' AND c.status = 'OPEN'
AND d.canteen_id = #{canteenId}
mapper.select: ORDER BY (d.view_count + d.favorite_count * 3 + d.review_count * 2) DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
ORDER BY d.favorite_count DESC, d.average_score DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
ORDER BY (CASE WHEN d.price > 0 THEN d.value_score / d.price ELSE 0 END) DESC, d.value_score DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.id AS dishId, d.name AS dishName, m.name AS merchantName, c.name AS canteenName, c.type AS canteenType, d.average_score AS score, d.price, d.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, d.view_count AS viewCount, d.review_count AS reviewCount, d.cover_image_url AS coverImageUrl, COUNT(f.id) AS feedbackCount FROM dish d INNER JOIN merchant m ON m.id = d.merchant_id INNER JOIN stall s ON s.id = d.stall_id INNER JOIN canteen c ON c.id = d.canteen_id LEFT JOIN feedback f ON f.dish_id = d.id AND f.status IN ('PENDING', 'VIEWED', 'ACCEPTED', 'IMPROVED')
GROUP BY d.id, d.name, m.name, c.name, c.type, d.average_score, d.price, d.favorite_count, d.view_count, d.review_count, d.cover_image_url ORDER BY feedbackCount DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
